adjudicator_note: Zero-token Phase A1 4-way adjudication of all 47 confirmed Lean papers (T0 + T1 + T2, v_latest) under the Track 1 4-gate decision tree, pending independent Phase B2 dual-rater (annotator_1 + annotator_2) IRR validation via track1_4way_coding_blank.csv.

records.rationale: G2 (Rule B3/B4): Verifies operational safety and block-synchronization protocol correctness for a BFT consensus system (retroactive v2 Lean formalization).

G3 (Rule B3): Proves quantitative cardinality and PF-PINI(2) side-channel leakage bounds (2*q^(2k-2)) over ZMod q for masked NTT/Montgomery modular-reduction pipelines rather than RTL/state-machine conformance; flagged borderline because domain is PQC hardware masking (annotator_1 coded software_or_system_fv in v0.6 IRR).
G3: Formalizes closed-loop Lyapunov stability, controllability, ISS, and observability theorems for an autonomous cyber-defense feedback control model.
G4 (Rule B4): Dynamic epistemic logic study (primary cs.LO) proving formal-logic semantics and knowledge/belief theorems for abstract gossip models.
G3: Proves convergence dynamics and phase diagrams for stochastic Muon vs. SignSGD optimization algorithms (retroactive v2 Lean formalization).

G3 (Rule B2): Introduces a semiparametric statistical/signal-processing estimator family (PATP) under non-Gaussian noise (eess.SP/stat.ME); borderline in v0.6 IRR only because the small Lean supplement stopped at supporting algebraic identities.
G2 (Rule B3): Verifies operational trust-boundary certificate invariants and deterministic structured wrappers for LLM software pipelines.

G2 (Rule B4): Verifies operational progress (conflict-freedom) and safety invariants for concurrent shared-memory universal constructions (PODC'26, retroactive v2); borderline with theoretical distributed computing in v0.6 IRR.

G3 (Rule B2/B5): Analyzes empirical risk minimization vs. population optimization landscapes for iterative nonconvex phase-retrieval methods (math.OC/cs.LG); flagged borderline because annotator_1 coded pure_tcs_or_math in v0.6 IRR.
G4 (Rule B4): Theoretical distributed computing paper establishing exact worst-case synchronous round complexity and impossibility for Counting in anonymous dynamic graphs.
G4 (Rule B4): Theoretical distributed graph-approximation paper (primary cs.DS) proving broadcast CONGEST covering-problem round bounds.

G3 (Rule B5): Integer linear programming / cutting-plane optimization theory (math.OC) proving polynomial-time constructible split-cut proofs and split-rank bounds; flagged borderline due to polyhedral-combinatorics flavor.
G4 (Rule B4): Theoretical distributed graph-algorithms paper proving CONGEST-model round bounds for planar SSSP and maximum flow.
G4 (Rule B4): Formal-logic decidability and undecidability characterization of distributed LTL reactive synthesis under message adversaries (cs.DC/cs.FL/cs.LO/eess.SY).
G3 (Rule B3): Proves quantitative statistical privacy/leakage bounds and simulator work bounds for continual matrix refreshing and leakage-resilient cryptographic circuit compilers.
G4 (Rule B3): Circuit-complexity and theoretical-cryptography reduction (primary cs.CC) proving TC^0 pseudorandomness and ReLU learning hardness from worst-case lattice problems.
G3: Proves an explicit O(log T) regret bound for Alternating Online Mirror Descent (AltOMD) in two-player zero-sum games.

G4 (Rule B5): Pure algebraic-geometry / function-field tower existence theorem (uniform 3-fold product expansion on the Garcia-Stichtenoth tower over F_729; cs.IT/math.AG); aligns with annotator_1 in v0.6 IRR.

G4 (Rule B5): Spectral/operator-theory theorem on resolvent-diagonal energy of isospectral Jacobi matrices and singular Schrodinger Green operators (math.OC/math.SP); aligns with annotator_1 in v0.6 IRR.
G3: Proves convergence bounds and step-size counterexamples for classical two-block ADMM convex optimization.
G2 (Rule B3): Verifies operational safety and convergence invariants of DBLog incremental snapshots handling orphan rows in database CDC pipelines (primary cs.DB).
G3: Proves global optimality and strong duality of the Bisect-Index-Choose (BIC) scheduling algorithm for EV charging under minimum-rate constraints (eess.SY).
G3: Proves finiteness, rigidity, and topological complexity bounds for fixed points of the binary Belief Propagation inference/decoding algorithm (cs.IT).
G3: Proves discretization error gaps and spurious-eigenpair obstructions for cubic Hermite Galerkin numerical PDE schemes on the boundary-dissipated KdV equation (math.NA/math.OC).
G3: Proves exponential iteration-complexity lower bounds and simplex/NNLS equivalence for Wolfe's minimum-norm-point optimization algorithm (math.OC).
G3: Proves exact worst-case convergence rates and half-step phase barriers for heavy-ball momentum optimization discretizations (math.OC).
G4 (Rule B5): Combinatorial graph-approximation paper (primary cs.DS) improving the subtour LP integrality gap for graphic TSP.

G1 (Rule B1): LongTails is an automated research and formal-verification framework generating >100 Lean-verified optimization bounds across many problem classes rather than proving a single original paper theorem; directly resolves annotator_1's v0.6 IRR note.

G3 (Rule B5): Gives an explicit construction of compressed-sensing RIP measurement matrices with k=m^{2/3-o(1)} and delta_k -> 0 (cs.IT/math.FA); flagged borderline because the proof machinery is extremal combinatorics and incidence geometry (Zahl/Guth-Zahl).
G3: Proves equilibrium stability and basin-of-attraction guarantees for discrete-time preconditioned/modified-gradient dynamical systems x_{k+1} = x_k + P_k grad f(x_k) (math.DS/math.OC).

G3 (Rule B3): Proves quantitative Reed-Solomon proximity-gap soundness error bounds for affine combiners used in FRI/WHIR cryptographic IOPP protocols (cs.IT/cs.CR; formalized inside leanEthereum/leanVM).
G4 (Rule B4): Theoretical distributed complexity paper (cs.DC/cs.DS) proving O(d^{3/2}) round complexity and lower bounds for sparse matrix multiplication in the low-bandwidth model.

G4 (Rule B5): Foundational quantum-information entropy inequality (subadditivity and SSA failure for Nichols-Wootters entropies; primary quant-ph/math-ph) with no concrete engineering algorithm or protocol analyzed.
G4 (Rule B5): Pure algebraic geometry / computability theorem (primary math.AG) proving undecidability and an octic counterexample for Hilbert's 17th problem on symmetric functions.
G3: Control-theoretic analysis of physically admissible boundary-actuation tracking, stochastic stability limits, and zero-gravity circulation for a mechanical chain fountain (math.OC).

G3 (Rule B1): Control/system-identification tutorial (eess.SY) proving ARX identifiability, discrete invariance, and an almost-sure sharpening of Ljung (1999) Lemma 3.1 (not a meta autoformalization pipeline).
G3: Proves finite-sample OLS/LASSO coefficient recovery and synchronous particle-SDE coupling error bounds for mesh-free weak-form interaction-kernel regression (stat.ML/math.OC).
G2 (Rule B3): Verifies operational admission-fencing completeness and contract-closure state-machine invariants for an AI-agent payment service (TrustBound, cs.CR).
G3: Analyzes quadrature-induced spurious local minima and convexity preservation in discrete optimal control of Lotka-Volterra dynamics (math.NA/math.OC).
G2 (Rule B3): Mechanizes operational type-confusion security and information-flow soundness invariants for an RPC core calculus (primary cs.PL, cross-listed cs.CR).
G3: Operations-research inventory control paper proving a 5/2 expected-cost optimality guarantee for echelon stock (s,S) policies in one-warehouse multi-retailer systems (math.OC).
G3 (Rule B3): Proves quantitative statistical variance and concentration bounds for differential indistinguishability in parallel mixnet routing networks (cs.CR).
G1 (Rule B1): Colombo is a self-organizing AI autoresearch system certifying claims across 50+ oracle-optimization settings (primary cs.AI); directly resolves annotator_1's v0.6 IRR note.

G3 (Rule B2/B5): Constructs addressable transversal CCZ gates on quantum LDPC codes and magic-state distillation protocols (quant-ph/cs.IT); flagged borderline because primary category is quant-ph and the partial Lean supplement verifies 3 companion-note algebraic lemmas.
G2 (Rule B3): Implements and verifies operational safety invariants of Tether, a stateful system-level security policy enforcement engine for AI agents (cs.CR).
G3 (Rule B5): Optimal pursuit-evasion / corridor barrier-guarding patrol control problem (math.OC/math.MG); flagged borderline due to metric-geometry / game-theoretic flavor.

G1 (Rule B1): Paper2Lean is an end-to-end agentic autoformalization pipeline releasing OptPaper-20 (formalizing 20 external optimization papers) rather than proving an original engineering theorem of its own.
